C0554.title: Pinduoduo Billion-Yuan Subsidy Coupon Exploit Incident
C0554.summary: In the early hours of January 20, 2019, Pinduoduo suffered a serious technical vulnerability that allowed users to claim 100-yuan no-threshold coupons. Black-market actors exploited the flaw by using new accounts and other methods to claim coupons in bulk, then used them for phone credit, Q coins, and other consumption or improper profit, causing losses to the platform. The platform said the vulnerability had been fixed, related orders were being traced, and the matter had been reported to police.
